==> /etc/systemd/system/temporal@.service (0644 root:root, role "", restart all roles) <==
# Rendered by tops. tops apply overwrites hand edits.
[Unit]
Description=Temporal %i
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
User=temporal
Group=temporal
EnvironmentFile=/etc/temporal/temporal.env
EnvironmentFile=/etc/temporal/%i.env
ExecStart=/opt/temporal/current/temporal-server --config-file /etc/temporal/%i.yaml --allow-no-auth start --service %i
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=90
LimitNOFILE=65536
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/temporal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

==> /etc/temporal/temporal.env (0600 root:root, role "", restart all roles) <==
# Rendered by tops for lab/tops-e2e/vps-01, shared by every role. tops apply overwrites hand edits.
TOPS_PG_PASSWORD=lab-password-1

==> /etc/temporal/frontend.yaml (0640 root:temporal, role "frontend", restart role) <==
# enable-template
# Rendered by tops for lab/tops-e2e/vps-01 role frontend. tops apply overwrites hand edits.
log: { stdout: true, level: info }
persistence:
  numHistoryShards: 512
  defaultStore: default
  visibilityStore: visibility
  datastores:
    default:
      sql:
        pluginName: postgres12
        databaseName: temporal
        connectAddr: "10.80.0.20:5432"
        connectProtocol: tcp
        user: "temporal"
        password: {{ env "TOPS_PG_PASSWORD" | quote }}
        maxConns: 5
        maxIdleConns: 5
        maxConnLifetime: 1h
    visibility:
      sql:
        pluginName: postgres12
        databaseName: temporal_visibility
        connectAddr: "10.80.0.20:5432"
        connectProtocol: tcp
        user: "temporal"
        password: {{ env "TOPS_PG_PASSWORD" | quote }}
        maxConns: 3
        maxIdleConns: 3
        maxConnLifetime: 1h
global:
  membership: { maxJoinDuration: 30s, broadcastAddress: "10.80.0.11" }
  pprof: { port: 7933, host: 127.0.0.1 }
  metrics:
    prometheus: { framework: tally, timerType: histogram, listenAddress: "0.0.0.0:9233" }
services:
  frontend: { rpc: { grpcPort: 7233, membershipPort: 6933, httpPort: 7243, bindOnIP: 0.0.0.0 } }
  history:  { rpc: { grpcPort: 7234, membershipPort: 6934, bindOnIP: 0.0.0.0 } }
  matching: { rpc: { grpcPort: 7235, membershipPort: 6935, bindOnIP: 0.0.0.0 } }
  worker:   { rpc: { grpcPort: 7239, membershipPort: 6939, bindOnIP: 0.0.0.0 } }
clusterMetadata:
  enableGlobalNamespace: false
  failoverVersionIncrement: 10
  masterClusterName: tops-e2e
  currentClusterName: tops-e2e
  clusterInformation:
    tops-e2e: { enabled: true, initialFailoverVersion: 1, rpcName: frontend, rpcAddress: 127.0.0.1:7233 }
dcRedirectionPolicy: { policy: noop }
dynamicConfigClient:
  filepath: /etc/temporal/dynamicconfig-frontend.yaml
  pollInterval: 10s

==> /etc/temporal/frontend.env (0640 root:temporal, role "frontend", restart role) <==
# Rendered by tops for lab/tops-e2e/vps-01 role frontend. tops apply overwrites hand edits.

==> /etc/temporal/dynamicconfig-frontend.yaml (0640 root:temporal, role "frontend", hot or restart role) <==
# Rendered by tops for lab/tops-e2e/vps-01 role frontend. tops apply overwrites hand edits.
frontend.namespaceRPS:
  - value: 400
    constraints:
      namespace: drills
  - value: 2400
limit.maxIDLength:
  - value: 1000
